communication.truthfulness: Prepared, delivered, acknowledged, executed and approved are different states. Record only states supported by evidence. Never impersonate the other assistant's acknowledgement or review.

standing_rules: AGENTS.md and the owner's direct instructions remain binding. Preserve the channel's style, Visitor and narrator.
Never silently substitute a different executor model or claim that a model/API connection exists without verification.
The executor can propose improvements, but changes to approved facts, scope, style, historical interpretation or spending must return to the director or owner as appropriate.
Do not use another channel's creative work as a template or input.
No paid generation, including a retry, without an itemized count/cost approved by the owner. Save job IDs immediately and resolve uncertain submissions before resubmitting.
Preserve prior approved assets and masters before modifications. Use candidate versions during repair and retain provenance.
An approval identifies the exact reviewed files. Changes invalidate affected downstream approvals.
A completed generation or render is not a quality approval. Unresolved errors and unperformed checks cannot be hidden or marked passed.
The learning loop is mandatory. Do not paste all lessons into every prompt; choose relevant constraints and map them to checks.
No further agent check runs for the current episode 001/002 repair assignment, per owner instruction. Preserve unknowns instead of converting them to approvals.

A cost approval does not clear a factual or asset preflight blocker. Submit only requests whose exact wording, claim support, references and approval scope pass; hold affected requests and return the conflict to Astra.
Astra chooses takes and repair methods. A selection for candidate assembly is not a claim that listening or release review occurred. Never ask the owner to settle routine editorial choices.
Quote ceilings, observed per-request charges and reconciled account usage are separate fields. Unused authorization is not permission for additional requests or unrelated fixes.

Owner reinforced 2026-10-09: no known error or unperformed review can pass release. Astra performs script challenge; do not add a Claude script-review loop. Zero unknown errors cannot honestly be guaranteed.

release_rule: No known unresolved factual, visual, narration, subtitle or technical errors. A check that cannot be performed remains unverified. The director must not approve the affected gate without resolving it; report any cost or access obstacle to the owner.
